_about: PARKED: the choreography pieces for Orb's homework 6 answer (2026-10-19): more back and forth, impacts, dynamic clashing; both fighters backflipping out of strikes and ricocheting off environmental elements (docs/combat/choreography-feel.md). For each piece: when it plays, its variants, its three beats with first-value ticks for Game Design to rule, each fighter's look, what it draws on, and the event Camera reads. Nothing is loaded or hashed

rules.bothActive: after every exit somebody is moving toward somebody
rules.noEndlessLoops: each piece has a count after which the exchange resolves

recoil.when: a blow separates the pair: the struck fighter's reel or knock-back, drawn by the blow's weight; control returns at the landing (the reel's own end)
recoil.stick: up a high backflip, down a low handspring; presentation inside the knock-back's own distance
recoil.surfaceBehind: a surface within the exit's distance makes it a ricochet

beats.anticipation: the blow's hit-stop, 4 ticks, the contact held
beats.followThrough: the rotation and the landing; the landing tick is when control returns

protagonist.handspring: two hands, a twist, lands facing the rival
protagonist.backflip: a layout, arms wide, a long open arc
protagonist.skip: a light bounce on the toes

rival.handspring: one hand down, the other in guard, lands square
rival.backflip: a compact tuck, lands in an exact crouch
rival.skip: a short slide back on both feet

needs.encounter: the exit by weight and state; the knock-back distance and the reel's length matched to it; the recoil event
needs.animation: skip, handspring, backflip as shared poses derived from gc.tech_flip and gc.bounce.rebound, flavour per fighter
needs.world: the ground point at the landing; a surface within the exit's distance

ricochet.when: a fighter sent along a line meets a surface below the wall slam's speed; above it, the wall slam or the building chain as ruled

face.plant: both feet flat on the wall, knees folding, a crack under the soles
face.rebound: mirrored off the normal, bent toward the rival

slope.plant: hands or feet set on the slant, ridge or cliff
slope.rebound: up and off it, toward the rival

prop.plant: on a parked car's roof, which crumples

post.plant: one hand catches a post or a tree and swings him round
post.rebound: a turned rebound round the post

counter.x: a flying knee or a jump kick
counter.b: a rebound heavy from his launch enders, legs.line (pending/launch/enders.json)
counter.none: he springs back unarmed, landing in range
counter.answer: the plant is a tell of at least 6 ticks; the rebound blow can be guarded and perfect-blocked

beats.anticipation: the flight toward the surface, then the plant (a 4-tick hit-stop and the crack); body, surface and rival framed together
beats.impact: the rebound blow's contact, or the plant with no press
beats.followThrough: the landing in range, or the rival's recoil exit

protagonist.wall: a running step up the face and a turning push-off
protagonist.rebound: a turning palm or an edge kick

rival.wall: a flat two-foot plant and a straight piston push
rival.rebound: a knee or the plate ram

event.name: ricochet
event.sentAt: when the send meets the surface on its path

needs.encounter: the first surface on the send's path; ricochet or wall slam by speed; the window; the rebound piece by button and family; the count; the event
needs.world: a surface query along a path (point, normal, kind, holds); cracks and dents below collapse; parked cars as hashed props
needs.animation: plant poses for the wall, the ground and the post with the feet or hands solved onto the surface point; the post swing

clash_meet.when: both fighters' blows would land inside the same few ticks: they meet between the bodies instead of both landing

x_x.then: both bounce back half a step; pressing again meets again, up to 3 in a row

b_b.meets: the heavy clash, a ring of force
b_b.then: both thrown into backflips (the double hit as today)

unequal.then: the lighter takes his handspring or skip

ends: break: one wins a meet by timing and his blow goes through
escalation: after the third meet, the fist clash's pulse contest (wave5)

beats.anticipation: both wind-ups seen together, framed in profile at equal weight
beats.impact: the meet at the midpoint, a 4 to 6-tick hit-stop and the spark or the ring
beats.followThrough: the split's two exits, or the winner's blow

protagonist.meets: an open palm that turns the other strike aside

rival.meets: the forearm plate square on, a dead stop

drawsOn: the clinch's grip layer as a paired contact

event.name: clash_meet
event.sentAt: when the two blows are found to meet

needs.encounter: two strike beats inside the meet window; the meet at the midpoint; resolution by strength and timing; the count; the events
needs.animation: both strikers' ends solved onto one point; a meet pose per strength for each fighter
needs.world: none, unless the B meet breaks glass (Game Design)

turn.when: a blow is deflected and the deflector's return comes at once; it can be deflected in turn: a ping-pong in place
turn.deflect: a guard press in the turn's window, wider than a perfect block's
turn.return: a quick blow from his stop pool (lines and rises) and his reversal pool
ends: a missed deflect: the blow lands and his recoil exit

beats.anticipation: the incoming wind-up, read on the defender's side
beats.impact: the deflect's spark, then at once the return's contact
beats.followThrough: the returner's step in: the swap of initiative

turn.camera: a 1% lean toward the new attacker at each swap

protagonist.deflect: a catch-and-turn: the palm leads the forearm past
protagonist.return: a rising palm or a palm push

rival.deflect: a forearm check: the plate stops it dead
rival.return: a straight fist or a knee

needs.encounter: the turn windows; the swap inside one exchange; the count; the event

big: every event carries big (Camera's one set piece in 20 s): true only on a B meet and on a ricochet whose counter launches
